name: Soul Draining Cage
description: Necromantic runes inscribed on the cage bars and lock drain the vitality of living creatures who interact with the cage.
disable: DC 25 Thievery check (expert) to drain the runes' power harmlessly or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the rune

offensiveAbilities.name: Soul Drain
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the cage bars, door, or lock directly or with a tool

Effect The trap deals 4d8+18 void damage to the triggering creature, creatures inside the cage, and all creatures adjacent to the cage (DC 27 basic Fortitude save). On a failed save, a creature is also Drained 1.
